notes.title: Hotfix 1.0
notes.content:
First off, if you haven't played the game yet, please make sure you have the latest patch as of 10.17.2024 by toggling steam to offline mode and back to online mode. This forces patch updates such as this one.

My deepest thanks to the people who let me know this was an issue so it could be fixed for everyone else and I really hope your experience was not ruined by this bug.

Enjoy the game and let me know if you find any more "holes" in the walls. This isn't an excuse, but a modification to that door last minute stripped it of its collision, a horrible oversight on my part.

Thank you again for playing the game.

Markco
